info.name: Spirit Medium
info.description: The Spirit Medium background from Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.

ul.li: Feat: A Dark Gift feat of your choice (Gathered Whispers is recommended)
Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Gaming Set (same as above), Basket, Bell, 8 Candles, Ink, Ink Pen, Paper (5 sheets), Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, and 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Through strange rituals and fateful encounters, you've discovered that you bear a unique connection to the spirits of the dead and damned. Your body is a conduit for such spirits, granting you prescient insight from beyond. But these spirits' intentions aren't always innocent, and their gifts come at a haunting cost.

setters.set: Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, a Dark Gift Feat, Insight and Religion Skills, a Gaming Set
